subject: How to add lines to a graph by using input$table_rows_selected

messages.author: 70d816b544c9b486
messages.subject: How to add lines to a graph by using input$table_rows_selected
parts:
How would I add lines to a renderPlot graph using the input$table_rows_selected?  I am looking for a way to add a new line in the plot for every line the user clicks on in the table.

The plot code looks like this to plot all the lines of the table:

plot(c(1, ncol(tFile)),
         range(as.matrix(tFile)),
           type = 'n',
           xaxt = 'n',
             las = 1,
           xlab = 'Experimental Points',
             ylab = 'Flux', ylim = c(-1 * input$Slider, input$Slider))
        matlines(t(tFile),
                 type = 'b',
                 lty = 1,
                 col = sample(rainbow(500)))
        axis(1, 1:ncol(tFile), colnames(tFile))

I would like to only plot user-selected lines from the table.

Thank you very much,
A N
